actions.action: Move the plant to the brightest spot, such as a south- or west-facing window, acclimating it gradually
Lift the plant out of the decorative pot and check for pooled water
Empty any standing water from the cachepot
Unpot and inspect the roots for rot
If roots are rotten, trim the damaged roots and repot in fresh cactus or herb mix with perlite or grit
Let the soil dry to 4–5 cm deep or nearly dry throughout, then water thoroughly and let it drain
Prune off dead or yellow stems
Share close-up photos of the roots or stems, or report how much direct sun the plant gets

reason: The plant was dehydrated, but the answer blames low light and overwatering and tells the owner to water even less, which would worsen the dehydration and delay the fix.
